title: POST /api/v1/batch answers a request-schema refusal with raw zod `issues` and no `fields[]`; the ADR-0114 field list is missing on the batch door
body:
qa#1 · os-justin · session_01QSeKYpxQpmErd1ixfkgbYh

## What happens
A malformed `/batch` body is refused 400 VALIDATION_FAILED, but the answer carries raw zod `issues` and no ADR-0114 `fields[]`. The per-object doors answer the same kind of failure with `fields[]`.

## Reproduction
Reproduced 3 times at `6091b645`, also noted in #34801.
- As admin, `POST /api/v1/batch` with `{"operations":"x"}` (or `{}`) → 400 `{"error":"Invalid batch request","code":"VALIDATION_FAILED","issues":[{"expected":"array","code":"invalid_type","path":["operations"],…}]}`.
- Contrast: `POST /api/v1/data/showcase_task/updateMany` with `{"records":[{"data":{}}]}` → 400 with `fields:[{field:'records.0.id',code:'required',…}]`.

## Mechanism
`packages/rest/src/batch-routes.ts` (around line 313) returns `issues: parsed.error?.issues`. The per-object branch in the same file (around lines 572–577) maps the same kind of failure through `zodIssuesToFields`. Related, but not the same: #9559 tracks where the envelope sits; this card is about the missing `fields[]`.
